thesis_bull: Deterministic large_cap_momentum_top5 signal fired ENTRY: WMT ranks #4 of 21 by 126-day return (+27.86%) with the SPY 10-month trend filter passing (SPY above 210d MA, +26.04% 12m). WMT was held 2026-05-18 through 2026-05-20 on this same momentum thesis and was closed only to sidestep the earnings print, not because the trend broke. Q1 FY27 results (BMO 2026-05-21) beat: EPS $0.66 vs $0.65 est, revenue $177.75B vs ~$174.65B est, Walmart US comps +4.1% with the strongest transaction growth in six quarters; membership + advertising now ~1/3 of operating income.
thesis_bear: The signal is computed on the 2026-05-20 daily close ($130.85), which is PRE-EARNINGS and PRE-REACTION. On today's Q1 FY27 print (BMO 2026-05-21) WMT fell ~8% DESPITE the revenue beat (sources below) — the market read guidance/margin commentary bearishly. Re-buying into a fresh -8% earnings gap, the same day, on a stale momentum signal, is the canonical retail mistake. Momentum signals computed on a pre-gap bar do not reflect the new information. CONFLICT: deterministic TA/momentum ENTRY vs fundamental/news reaction strongly bearish — per CLAUDE.md the bear thesis dominates and confidence is lowered. Additional caution: the portfolio is in a soft daily-loss breach today (-$1,727.72 / -1.71% vs the session open; cap -$500/-0.5%), a defensive posture that argues against adding fresh risk on the same session. Counter-evidence carried verbatim: an 8% earnings-day drop on a revenue beat can mean-revert, and the underlying 6-month momentum rank is still top-5 — but acting on a stale pre-gap price is not how this is captured; the next EOD will re-rank on the post-earnings bar.
